verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool with a CLI, machine-readable outputs, and an HCP Terraform platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of versioned APIs, compatibility guarantees, or a deprecation policy. The 'version, reuse, and share' docs refer to versioning users' own configuration files, which is an adjacent feature, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path.
